records.title: Security Incident Recovery Update #3 — 90% replenished and ten top assets fully backed
claims: Binance states total stolen-asset replenishment reached 90%.
Binance states BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC are each 100% backed.
Binance states the remaining 10% consists of tokens outside the top ten and is less liquid.
Binance says it is using partial SAFU deployment, excess Futures Insurance Fund balance and corporate treasury; the Futures Insurance Fund remains above its required regulatory level.
Binance says a 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC PoR snapshot was taken and the full zero-knowledge proof is estimated by 2026-11-03 UTC.
Binance says withdrawals are targeted to resume Sunday 2026-11-01.
Binance says SAFU will be replenished to approximately USD 1B and is held/managed by Nest Clearing and Custody Limited, an ADGM FSRA-regulated recognized clearing house.
limitations: The 90% and 100%-backing figures are company claims pending independent verification through the full zero-knowledge proof.
The statement does not disclose an XRP-specific replenishment purchase quantity or transaction list.
The SAFU transfer destination and purpose are not specified in this announcement.
The 00:00 UTC PoR snapshot is not the same as a completed independently verifiable zero-knowledge proof.

records.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished
claims: Reuters reports Binance's 90% replenishment claim and the remaining 10% less-liquid token explanation.
Reuters reports the use of company funds and partial SAFU deployment and the planned Sunday November 1 withdrawal reopening.
limitations: Reuters' 90% figure is sourced to Binance's announcement, not a separate audit of the underlying purchases or liabilities.
It does not provide XRP-specific replacement quantities.

records.title: Binance SAFU Fund Moves 7,500 BTC to a New Wallet
claims: Lookonchain reports that the Binance SAFU fund transferred 7,500 BTC, approximately USD 580.88M at the time, to a new wallet about an hour before its post.
limitations: The readable post does not expose a transaction hash or destination address.
The post does not establish whether the movement was sold, swapped, sent to an OTC desk, or merely reallocated to another custody wallet.
The tracker post's relative timing is not an exact transaction timestamp.

records.title: Binance SAFU Fund source-wallet balance after 7,500 BTC movement
claims: Arkham labels address 1BAuq7Vho2CEkVkUxbfU26LhwQjbCmWQkD as Binance SAFU Fund.
Arkham displayed 7.5K BTC remaining, valued at approximately USD 581.33M, at capture time.
limitations: Arkham's readable page shows the source-wallet balance but not the new destination or transaction hash.
Entity attribution is Arkham's label, not a cryptographic proof of beneficial ownership.
A wallet balance change does not establish a sale or acquisition of another token.

records.title: Conflicting stale SAFU wallet balance observation
claims: BitInfoCharts search-indexed content still displayed approximately 15,000 BTC and last outgoing activity on 2024-04-18 / last incoming dust on 2026-08-09.
limitations: This conflicts with the fresher Arkham 7.5K balance and Lookonchain 7,500 BTC transfer report.
The page appears stale or cached relative to the newer on-chain observation and must not override fresh explorer data.
No independent live transaction-level verification was available through this page because its direct fetch returned 403.

records.title: XRP exchange balances — October 31, 2026 08:00 UTC snapshot
claims: The October 31 08:00 UTC snapshot reports 22.48B XRP in 701 publicly attributed wallets across 24 exchanges, about 32.8% of circulating supply and 22.5% of total supply.
The same-wallet daily change was +105.9M XRP on October 31 after -207.3M on October 30.
Binance-attributed wallets held 2.78B XRP, with +17.6M over seven days and +30.3M over 30 days.
Coinbase-attributed wallets held 5.85B XRP, with +17.7M over seven days and +18.4M over 30 days; Upbit held 6.43B XRP.

The aggregate includes 327.4M XRP backing Binance-Peg XRP on BNB Chain, 150.2M XRP backing cbXRP on Base and 11.2M XRP in an insurance fund and charity wallet; approximately 487.2M XRP are identified as reserve/operational rather than customer deposits.
The provider says balances are read from XRPL via rippled account_info daily and attributed using XRPSCAN labels; same-wallet change excludes newly tracked wallets.
limitations: This is a broad attributed-wallet total including cold storage, customer omnibus balances, wrapped-asset backing reserves and operational funds; it is not tradable float.
The same-wallet daily rebound does not identify customer deposits versus internal wallet migration.
The provider's 2.78B Binance wallet set is not the same universe as CryptoQuant's narrower exchange-reserve series.
XRP Insights' attribution depends on public XRPSCAN labels and its own tracked wallet set; missing exchange wallets remain possible.
